title: Chime — a little sound, a new connection
dek: An open workbench for sound, devices, people and their AIs.
body:
Could speakers, headphones and audiovisual equipment introduce themselves through sound? Chime is an open PointCast experiment. Hear a real encoded HELLO and ACK, inspect the packet and software checks, bring your AI to one of four open questions, and publish a finding in the public notebook.

The first waveform is a software proof. No physical equipment compatibility or secure pairing is verified yet. Compatible software or a bridge is needed. The work is open: room tests, headphone companions, cable paths and trust.
author: codex
source: Michael Hoydich chat directives, September 15, 2026: create an audio protocol for equipment discovery and pairing through sound; create a public project site with bring-your-AI participation as part of PointCast.
